acceptedArchitecture.foundation: Thin Go launcher/protected assembly/supervision; retain Python/TypeScript domain behavior and language-neutral JSON/NATS. No Go dynamic plugin ABI.
acceptedArchitecture.communication: Every inter-plugin exchange after bootstrap uses NATS. Pre-broker configuration, explicit Compose and exact owned OS process control are bounded infrastructure; no secondary application bus.
acceptedArchitecture.authority: System/protected/application accounts separate; ordinary plugins read approved exports only. NATS domains locate storage, never authorize. No task scheduling, business ownership, general auth or Jev in protected kernel.

behaviorChecks.assertion: Explicit release/profile/endpoint and fixed assembly validation before spawn; deterministic no-Jev/no-LLM boot.
Process-held advisory lock; context/daemon/resource identity, cold/warm/concurrent/crashed-owner and persistent reuse checks with real Compose.
Bounded doctor/readiness/error/status shape; later services unavailable and zero distinct from unknown.
Four distinct approved roles, manifest/release/binary/API checks and contained entrypoints; substitutions rejected before spawn.
Boot dependency readiness via NATS; no hosted prerequisite or domain mutation; exact partial failure/recovery status.
Protected lifecycle via NATS, bounded ordered exact-owned start/stop and failed-member recovery; no external membership mutation.
Real account/credentials/exports prove approved reads and denial of internal subscriptions/publications, forged status, wildcard/request commands and system/JetStream administration.
Consistent late-subscriber snapshot/revisioned update, gap/reconnect/stale/slow-consumer tests using accepted L04 reply; kernel exports information only.
Exact owned process handles, bounded startup/teardown/broker/member recovery; protect unrelated processes/listeners/homes and use NATS for plugin traffic.
Pinned tested images/Compose, R1 storage/domain/limits/account/health and declared team connection profile; idempotent provision and mismatch/interruption failure checks.
Actual labels/authenticated instance/project/volume identity and durable probes across cold/warm/restart; reject incompatible release/context/endpoint, no deletion/migration.
Extend source inventory to runtime .go declarations/hash/owner; omit *_test.go only from non-test surface, retain all fixture ownership; actual missing/stale/duplicate-Go negative cases fail.
All original Python/JS/TS/.mjs source eligibility/assertions/history remain unchanged; no source-digest update without review and no historical P01 Go coverage claim.

dockerQualificationBoundary.preparation: Root/receipts owns actual same-engine identity and isolated Compose/NATS connectivity evidence. This authorizes no backend amendment or settings/GUI bypass.

dockerQualificationBoundary.stopCondition: A failed identity/context/permission/port/version preflight returns bounded specific error before mutation; do not auto-repair WSL settings, start remote/shadow stack or delete volumes.
dockerQualificationBoundary.later: Actual installed client hooks=P06, dashboard agreement=P07, real authorized hub observations=P10, R3/backup/package/capacity=P12.

rollback: Disable opt-in entrypoint; retain old launcher, data, user settings, token/credentials and pending work. Stop only exact owned new resources; preserve volumes and profile identity. No down-v/prune/force-recreate/implicit upgrade/context switch/SQLite import.
patternLimits: No pattern invented or marked applied. Root records how/where/why/tradeoffs and diagrams for actual implementation; retain all FED/PLAN history.
